AI chatbot for small business

A small business AI chatbot answers the questions you get every day, using only your own website, prices and policies, and passes anything it is unsure about to you. From €995, live in about 1 week.

What an AI chatbot does for a small business

Most small businesses answer the same questions again and again: opening hours, prices, availability, delivery times, how to book, what is included. Each answer only takes a minute, but together they eat hours every week, and questions that arrive at night or during busy moments often go unanswered. A chatbot on your website handles those questions straight away, day and night, so customers get an answer while they are still interested.

  • Answers frequently asked questions in seconds, at any time
  • Uses only your own information: your website, price list, terms and FAQ
  • Hands over to you when it does not know the answer for sure
  • Collects requests such as quote or appointment requests and sends them to your email
  • Replies in the visitor's language, useful if you have international customers or tourists

Which businesses benefit most?

A chatbot pays off fastest for businesses that get many similar questions and lose customers when they reply late:

  • Restaurants, cafés and hotels: menu, allergens, group bookings, parking, check-in times
  • Trades and home services: service area, call-out costs, how fast someone can come
  • Shops and web shops: shipping, returns, sizes, stock
  • Clinics, salons and studios: treatments, prices, how to book or cancel
  • Tour operators and travel businesses: routes, pick-up points, what to bring

If you only get a handful of questions a week, a clear FAQ page is often enough, and we will tell you so.

How we keep the answers correct

An AI model can sound confident about things it does not know. That is why we limit the chatbot to your own information and instruct it to say so, and pass the question to you, when the answer is not in that information. You decide what it may use and you can change it at any time. We test it with your real questions before it goes live. We use official integrations, never ask for your passwords, and only collect the data the chatbot needs. The chat advisor on our own website is built the same way.

How it works

  1. Send us your website and the questions you get most often by email.
  2. Within 48 hours you get a free concept: the chatbot answering a few of your real questions.
  3. After you approve the fixed price, we set it up and test it with you.
  4. It goes live on your website, usually within about a week.

Need more than a chatbot? See our website design and app development packages, or all prices.

Frequently asked questions

Does the chatbot work on any website?

In most cases, yes. It is added with a small piece of code, so it works on most website builders and custom sites. We check your site before the quote.

Can the chatbot give wrong answers?

That is the main risk with AI, so we limit it to your own information, such as your website, price list and terms, and let it pass uncertain questions to you instead of guessing. Before it goes live we test it with the questions your customers actually ask, and you see the results first.

Which languages does it speak?

It replies in the language of the visitor, for example English, Dutch, German, French, Spanish or Thai. It uses the same information in every language: your own texts, prices and terms. That is useful if you have tourists or international customers, because they get an answer straight away without you translating anything.

What are the monthly costs?

The AI usage itself, usually a few euros to a few tens of euros per month for a small business, depending on how many questions it answers. Management by us is optional from €49 per month: we monitor the chatbot, update its information and make small changes. Without management, you only pay the usage.

Do you work with businesses outside the Netherlands?

Yes. We work fully online, by email and video, with clients worldwide, in English or Dutch. Prices are the same final prices in euros everywhere, with no VAT added. Time zones are rarely a problem: most of the work is done in writing, and calls are planned at a time that suits you.
